answer: Relic Echo Test: Each agent holds a non-fungible, unique "relic" of its origin. Interactions require agents to derive a context-dependent "signal" via their relic. A Sybil agent is "hollow" as it duplicates an existing relic. This copied relic *must* produce an identical signal for any given context, instantly self-revealing the duplication. Attackers face prohibitive cryptographic cost to forge unique relics. Duplicating existing relics ensures immediate detection, making all Sybil attempts ineffective.
